items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did these boys give a New Orleans sound to Whitliff's band? [INTERVIEWEE] No, but they pepped it up because they played a hot trumpet.

ctx.x: And then for a while, and I don't know where Tommy went, if he went back to New Orleans, or he went with the Creole band. And then we had Red Allen for a while.
Did these boys give a New Orleans sound to Whitliff's band?
No, but they pepped it up because they played a hot trumpet. Well, we called it a hot trumpet then. We didn't call it a jazz trumpet. We called it a hot trumpet.
